{"status": "NO_PLAN", "reasons": ["CS3282 requires CS3281. The student must take CS3281 and CS3282 in the same semester (Sem 8) or CS3281 in an earlier semester. If CS3281 is in Sem 7, it conflicts with CS4239 which requires CS3235 (prereq: CS2105, CS2106, CS2107). CS2105/CS2106/CS2107 must be taken before CS3235. CS2100 is required for CS2106. CS2100/CS2103T/CS2107 in Sem 3 (12MC). CS2105/CS2106 in Sem 4 (8MC). CS3235 in Sem 5 (4MC). CS4239 in Sem 7 (4MC). CS3281 in Sem 7 would make Sem 7 have CS4239 + CS3281 = 8MC. Then CS3282 + CS2109S in Sem 8 (8MC). This works for MC. However, CS3233 is required. CS3233 is offered only in Sem 2 (even semesters: 4, 6, 8). Sem 6 is NOC. So CS3233 must be in Sem 4 or 8. If in Sem 4, Sem 4 has CS2105, CS2106, CS3233 = 12MC. This fits. So: Sem 3: CS2100, CS2103T, CS2107. Sem 4: CS2105, CS2106, CS3233. Sem 5: CS3235. Sem 6: NOC. Sem 7: CS4239, CS3281. Sem 8: CS3282, CS2109S. Check prereqs: CS3281 needs CS2103T (Sem 3). OK. CS3282 needs CS3281 (Sem 7). OK. CS2109S needs CS2040S, MA1521. OK. CS4239 needs CS3235 (Sem 5) and CS2103T (Sem 3). OK. CS3235 needs CS2105 (Sem 4), CS2106 (Sem 4), CS2107 (Sem 3). OK. CS2105/CS2106 need CS2100 (Sem 3). OK. All hard constraints met. Why did the previous answer fail? It said CS3282 in Sem 8 requires CS3281 in Sem 8. But CS3281 can be in Sem 7. The previous plan put CS3281 in Sem 8. The revised plan puts CS3281 in Sem 7. This is valid.
